name: Environmental Studies - BS
narrative:
MAJOR REGULATIONSPREREQUISITES Check the General Catalog for the prerequisites to all listed courses.
P/NP GRADING OPTION Env S 190 must be taken P/NP, and up to 4 units of Env S 192 may be taken P/NP for major credit. All other courses, including those applied to the major from other departments must be taken for letter grades.
SUBSTITUTIONS In the major requirements permissible only by petition to the department chair and dean.
G.P.A REQUIREMENTS At least 2.0 overall UC average in all UD major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major.
DOUBLE MAJORS With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to upper-division areas A and/or B and the other upper-division major.

items.description: One course from each of the following three clusters of courses:

items.label: B-1
items.notes: Cross-listed courses may be taken through other departments.

items.label: B-2
items.description: Any courses in upper-division Environmental Studies, with no more than 8 units combined and 4 units each from Environmental Studies 192, 194, 199, 199RA.

items.label: B.
items.description: 32 UD Environmental Studies elective units not used in Area A, including at least 20 units from B-1

items.label: OPTION 1
items.description: 16 upper-division units from one of the following departments
items.notes:
- Mathematics 100A-B will not apply.
- Only courses that apply towards the B.S. Physical Geography major will apply.

items.text: 16 units from the departments listed in Option 1 forming a coherent focus. A plan of study listing the courses to be taken must be approved by petition by the department chair. Students must consult a department advisor prior to starting this option.
items.label: OPTION 2 Interdisciplinary Concentration

items.text: Double major within one of the departments listed in Option 1 or with a BS major in the Psychological and Brian Sciences department. These 16 units would apply simultaneously to both Environmental Studies and the second major.
items.label: OPTION 3

requirement.label: Upper-Division Environmental Studies
requirement.description: 49-50 UD units from Areas A and B plus a 16-unit outside concentration (Area C)
requirement.notes: NOTE: All courses (including cross-listed courses) may only apply to one area of the major.
